assessment.nobel_worthiness: A powerful set of exact results that made nonequilibrium statistical mechanics more quantitative and connected microscopic dynamics to measurable work and entropy production.
assessment.attribution: The listed contributions capture complementary formulations and derivations; the relationship among the early fluctuation relations makes precise credit and the prize's scope important.
assessment.maturity: The framework has been tested and applied over decades, with mature theoretical and experimental foundations.
uncertainties: The results emerged through closely related work, so selecting a compact and fair laureate group is difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identifying anyons as a new possibility for particle statistics in two dimensions was a conceptually deep advance with lasting consequences for quantum matter.
assessment.attribution: The listed theorists made foundational contributions to the idea; later developments and applications should not obscure the distinct early conceptual work.
assessment.maturity: Anyons are now embedded in the understanding of quantum Hall systems and topological phases, supported by extensive theoretical and experimental work.
uncertainties: The boundary between the original theoretical discovery and later physical realization may affect how the achievement is framed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory supplied a general and tractable framework for strongly correlated electrons, turning difficult many-body problems into a productive research program.
assessment.attribution: The three listed theorists are central to establishing and developing the method; the contribution is collective but sufficiently identifiable.
assessment.maturity: The method has been used and extended for decades and has been tested against experiments and more complete numerical approaches.
uncertainties: Its status as a single discovery is less clear because its impact accumulated through extensions and broad adoption.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Topological order and long-range entanglement introduced organizing principles for quantum phases beyond conventional symmetry breaking.
assessment.attribution: Kitaev and Wen represent distinct but deeply related foundational lines of work; the scope of the proposed achievement needs careful definition.
assessment.maturity: The concepts have matured through decades of theory and experimental work on topological quantum materials.
uncertainties: The discovery encompasses several related ideas, so its boundaries and attribution are not as compact as a single result.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Experimental access to fractional charge and anyonic statistics probes the defining microscopic properties of a remarkable quantum state.
assessment.attribution: The named researchers represent important experimental contributions, though the experiments relied on a broad sequence of earlier quantum Hall discoveries and device advances.
assessment.maturity: Fractional charge is well established; evidence for anyonic statistics has advanced substantially but remains sensitive to experimental interpretation and platform.
uncertainties: The strength and independence of the evidence for statistics, and how to distinguish it from related interference effects, remain relevant.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks transformed precision timekeeping and opened stringent tests of fundamental physics through a major advance in atomic measurement.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye made distinctive, parallel contributions to the central clock concepts and their realization.
assessment.maturity: The technology is exceptionally mature, with rapidly improving performance and broad independent validation.
uncertainties: The scientific recognition may depend on whether the prize emphasizes the clock concept, its realization, or the wider precision-measurement field.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Active-matter hydrodynamics identified robust collective behavior in systems that consume energy locally, giving a striking theoretical account of flocking and related phenomena.
assessment.attribution: The listed theorists made influential contributions, but the field developed through many connected models, experiments, and communities.
assessment.maturity: The core ideas are well established, while the field's broader synthesis and experimental reach continue to develop.
uncertainties: It is uncertain whether the field has a sufficiently bounded discovery and settled attribution for a prize now.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The development of two-dimensional conformal field theory produced an unusually powerful framework spanning statistical physics and quantum field theory.
assessment.attribution: The listed theorists made central foundational contributions, but the achievement is distributed across a broad and rapidly developing body of work.
assessment.maturity: The framework has been established for decades and remains deeply influential.
uncertainties: Its broad mathematical and theoretical scope makes it harder to isolate a single physics discovery and a bounded set of contributors.
